senses.gloss: the clay used for sealing wine vessels, sealing clay.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:2:20">Y. Ber. IX, 13ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>כדי שתשרה המ׳</he> so much rain that the sealing clay looks as if dissolving; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:3:3">Y. Taan. I, 64ᵇ</cite> top (not <he>שתשרף</he>); a. e.

<cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 2:14">Tosef. Bets. II, 14</cite>; Y. ib. II, 61ᶜ bot. <he>היו מכניסין … במ׳</he> they brought the burning perfume (<cite ref="M00401"><he>מוּגְמָר</he></cite>) into the dining room (on a Holy Day) in an air-tight vessel.
